status.title: Status
status.backupBody: The database is backed up regularly (timestamped PostgreSQL dump, last 7 backups kept) via 'make backup'. In case of an incident, a backup can be restored manually to resume service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: We collect your username, your email and your password (hashed with Argon2, never stored in plain text) when you create your account.
privacy.section2Body: We use your data only within Task Manager, whether for authentication or for any activity on the platform.
privacy.section3Body: Your data is kept from the creation of your account until it is deleted.
privacy.section4Body: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access your data, to have it corrected, and to request its deletion along with your account.
privacy.section5Body: Your data is never shared outside the project; only you and the project team with administrator access can access it.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about your data, contact the project team.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Body: By creating an account, you agree to these terms of service.
terms.section2Body: You are responsible for keeping the information used to sign in to your account confidential, as well as for all activity carried out from it. You are also required to provide accurate information when creating your account.
terms.section3Body: You must use the platform in a fully lawful manner, without storing or sharing illegal content. You must also not compromise the security of the platform.
